findings_addressed.oracle: Independent recursive count of cache_control keys over the mutated kwargs dict, asserted to equal exactly 3 (system block + last tool + last message block). The previous upper-bound-only check (`<= 4`) admitted 0 markers and could not detect a gutted implementation. The new exact equality check (`== 3`) is falsified by any implementation that omits any of the three placement sites.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/anthropic.py _apply_cache_breakpoints, remove the `AnthropicProvider._cache_last_message_block(messages_list)` call (lines 341-342). This drops the message-block breakpoint, reducing the count from 3 to 2 and failing `assert n == 3`.

findings_addressed.oracle: Hard assert `usage is not None` (replaces the former `pytest.skip` guard). Independent re-computation invariant: `total_tokens == prompt_tokens + completion_tokens`. Cache-hit gate: `cache_read_tokens is not None and > 0` stays red because UsageInfo lacks the field and _build_usage_from_message never extracts cache_read_input_tokens.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/anthropic.py _build_usage_from_message, change `total_tokens=input_tokens + output_tokens` to `total_tokens=input_tokens + output_tokens + 1` — that breaks the `usage.total_tokens == usage.prompt_tokens + usage.completion_tokens` assertion immediately. Alternatively, make the function always `return None` — that breaks the new `assert usage is not None` gate.

prod_defects.expected: UsageInfo returned by _build_usage_from_message should include cache_read_tokens and cache_creation_tokens fields populated from response.usage.cache_read_input_tokens and response.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens respectively, so the live gate can assert cache_read_tokens > 0 on the second identical cached request
prod_defects.actual: _build_usage_from_message constructs UsageInfo with only prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens; cache usage fields are silently discarded; UsageInfo dataclass has no cache_read_tokens attribute so getattr(usage, 'cache_read_tokens', None) returns None and the cache-hit assertion fails with AssertionError

notes: Two tests re-hardened in this pass. (1) test_breakpoint_count_within_anthropic_limit: replaced the tautological upper-bound-only check (`<= 4`, admits 0) with an exact-equality oracle (`== 3`) that counts all three placement sites independently of the production code path being tested. (2) test_repeated_cached_prompt_reports_cache_read: replaced the `if usage is None: pytest.skip(...)` skip guard (N3/N6 pattern — accepts-both-outcomes) with `assert usage is not None`, turning the most important regression path (missing usage extraction) into a hard failure. The cache_read_tokens gate intentionally stays RED, correctly documenting the production defect that _build_usage_from_message discards Anthropic cache usage fields.
